name: Masaki Gaillard
source:
A bright girl who lives in the same house that [url=/c12414]Tooru[/url] is lodging in. She works in a bar and is also the mascot character for the business. Some folks think that she’s childish at times, but she has an unexpected maturity about her which she uses to manage various situations. Called a therianthrope, Masaki is a hybrid of human and beast, which makes her have human-like features, along with a tail and ears of the therianthrope species. This species closely resembles a wolf. Loves eating, but especially favors donuts, of which Masaki claims “I have a different stomach for donuts”.

[Taken from [url=http://www.dannychoo.com/en/post/26860/Amairo+Islenauts.html]Danny Choo's blog[/url] and [url=https://vnerogereview.wordpress.com/2013/08/04/pure-love-story-on-a-fantasy-island-review-of-130726amairo-islenauts/]Visual Novels and Eroge Review[/url]]
